name: printnow-project
description: Root convenience scripts only - each module (module1-student-app, module2-shop-dashboard, module3-backend, module5-admin, module6-print-agent) is still its own independent app with its own package.json/node_modules. This file just saves you from opening 5 terminals and running npm install/npm run dev in each one by hand.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix module3-backend install && npm --prefix module1-student-app install && npm --prefix module2-shop-dashboard install && npm --prefix module5-admin install && npm --prefix module6-print-agent install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,student,shop,admin -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm --prefix module3-backend run dev" "npm --prefix module1-student-app run dev" "npm --prefix module2-shop-dashboard run dev" "npm --prefix module5-admin run dev"
